notes.title: New Expansion: Explore the Mysteries of Egypt in The Foretold Westmark Legacy
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

We're excited to announce that The Foretold: Exordium has found its way into The Foretold Westmark Legacy as a free addition! This new campaign takes players to the mysterious deserts of Egypt, offering an action-packed adventure that emphasizes combat over the story-driven experience of the main game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244752/d6564ba283339d9889696629fa5168128952560b.png[/img]

In this update, you'll explore a new map and face off against fearsome monsters. The Egyptian campaign provides an opportunity for players to test their combat skills and dive into fresh, thrilling challenges that enrich the Westmark Legacy experience.

Whether you're a returning player or new to the world of Westmark, this addition brings exciting content and a chance to expand your journey. Update your game today and experience the thrill.

If you enjoy the new content, we’d love to hear your thoughts - please leave a review on Steam and let us know how you liked the new campaign. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1746400/The_Foretold_Westmark_Legacy/

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
This patch fixed issues with Mind balance and item drops.

Gameplay changes
[list]
[*]Alert (Mind persona) now gives +3 damage instead of +1 shield each turn, this should give mind the needed extra damage.
[*]Mind shield node now gives +10 max shield instead of +8 max shield.
[*]Added extra rewards for the starting nodes in higher difficulties.
[/list]
Item changes
[list]
[*]Gun now gives bonus pierce damage +6 (once per phase) instead of +6 damage.
[*]Added a new consumable cookie for HARD and CHAOTIC that gives bonus to damage.
[/list]
Bugfixes
[list]
[*]Timothy achievement now works properly.
[*]Pocket knife no longer shows up as equipable on tooltip.
[/list]

Bigger changes to puzzles and enemies are coming soon as well.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.2 brings a lot of bug fixes and some balance changes, everything is listed below.

Bugs fixed
[list]
[*]Attempted to fix issues with loading in to a black screen.
[*]Number previews on cards will no longer stay forever sometimes.
[*]Dementia from curse now stays in the same slot and will not give you a blank slot sometimes afterwards.
[*]Recovery of health and shield from curses now gives the correct amount and shows the correct amount in the persona panel.
[*]Passive relics now correctly requires you to equip them, but you should find more items to increase the number of equipped relics you can have now.
[/list]
Item and creature changes
[list]
[*]Toadman now uses the correct attacking order.
[*]Last zombie have been tweaked with some new abilities and a bit lower health and damage.
[*]Carriageman now counts as a boss in regards to rewards, and is slightly easier.
[*]Crown of Solomon now gives 2 life regen instead of 1.
[*]Added some permanent health, shield and dodge rewards to the map.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
This patch makes a lot of smaller adjustments to a lot of areas to make progression smoother, and fixes some critical issues with random drops.

Creature changes
[list]
[*]Drunkard now attacks every 2nd turn and switches to his more dangerous attack faster.
[*]The fly got a slight reduction to health.
[*]Reduced damage and hp of mummy in the early and lategame.
[*]George got a slight reduction to health.
[*]Craven got reduced damage for the early power levels and the leech got reduced a bit.
[*]All creatures in normal difficulty got a 10% reduction in overall power as well.
[/list]
Item changes
[list]
[*]Tooltip for items now works correctly all the time.
[*]Ember ring got a damage increase.
[*]Book of blemish got reduced focus requirement.
[*]Wooden stake now has +2 pierce but only +3 damage.
[*]Fixed critical issue where some of the relics where not available for random drops.
[*]More unknown item drops and gold in the later levels.
[*]More identify scrolls and gold early on.
[*]Lots of other smaller adjustments made to drop rates of relics and weapons.
[/list]
Skill changes
[list]
[*]Persona skill number five will now be found one persona point earlier.
[*]Completing achievements will now grant permanent bonuses that you will find on the first persona point (requires restart)
[/list]
Card changes
[list]
[*]Pin card will now allow cards above to travel freely and fall below if possible.
[*]Slight reduction in cost of cards on all difficulties.
[/list]
Map changes
[list]
[*]If you have met Edith you will speak to her otherwise you get a surprise instead.
[*]The floor sigil in the estate can only be accessed once now.
[*]Special savepoints have been added in the last spot before you face the boss.
[/list]

notes.title: What now?
notes.notes:
[h2]Thank you all for the support and for playing the game!  [/h2]

Hi, it's Martin, the creative director on this project. I would like to thank you all who tried the game out and gave us your feedback, we have taken these last few days collecting information from you all, and have a good plan on where to go from here.

We make a [b]small balancing change for the game before this weekend[/b] to make it a bit easier for newcomers, and make small improvements on some encounters. We will also amend small issues that have come up that should not be there.

If you have any questions or suggestions feel free to comment below!

notes.title: The Darkness Arrives
notes.notes:
[h1]We are announcing our next project that we will be working on for the coming years. Westmark Legacy is a spiritual successor to the dark survival horror game Westmark Manor.[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1158970/Westmark_Manor/

Plan is to change it up a bit on every new Westmark itteration to keep it fresh and interesting.

We havent gone out with too many details on gameplay yet but hope to fill you in as we work on it! This is an ample time to come with thoughts, ideas, questions or just inspirations because we would love to make this the best cozy horror IP out there! For the lovers of all creepy and macabre.
For the players that dont want jumpscares and too stressful situations.

The goal is to make a horror you can enjoy that is frightning but in a more psychological way. So feel free to shoot us a message here or on twitter (where i mostly dwell) @nodbrim

[img]https://nodbrim.com/____impro/1/onewebmedia/PromoWide.gif?etag=W%2F%22120b80e-6149a1c5%22&sourceContentType=image%2Fgif&ignoreAspectRatio&resize=981%2B315&extract=0%2B0%2B940%2B315[/img]

[b]Wishlists and spreading the word is how we get this game to the finishline so help us out![/b]

Thank you and stay sane!
